## Problem

What is broken or missing, and why does it matter?

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior. Note migrations, saved-setting changes or compatibility effects when relevant.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and results. For device checks, name the device/Android version and tested commit. State what remains unverified. Documentation-only changes do not need an APK rebuild.

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, add real before/after captures or explain the new screen. Use non-private data and identify fixture captures.
